_comment: Ultimate Texas Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[4x]', '[2x]', '[1x]', '[check]', '[c]', '[fold]', '[f]', '[skip]', '[s]', '[play bet 4x]', ...), the card labels/suits (e.g. 'A♠', 'K♥', '10♦'), the phase labels passed in {phase}, or any numeric chip/bet/payout amounts. The escaped literal '${{...}}' fragments in the rules pay table reproduce a pre-existing display bug verbatim and must be kept exactly (double braces are intentional).

_slots.{hand}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'A♠, K♥', or the localized no-cards text
_slots.{phase}: The current phase label token (PRE-ROUND, PRE-FLOP, FLOP, RIVER, SHOWDOWN)
_slots.{actions}: A comma-separated list of bracketed action tokens, e.g. '[play_bet_4x], [check]'
_slots.{available}: A comma-separated list of currently legal bracketed action tokens
_slots.{cards}: A comma-separated list of card labels, e.g. 'Q♣, 7♦, 2♠'
_slots.{name}: A localized poker hand name, inserted verbatim
_slots.{net}: The net chip change for the round (may be negative)

player_prompt.rules:
🎯 ULTIMATE TEXAS HOLD'EM - Pemain Tunggal vs Dealer

📖 GAMBARAN GAME:
• Sampeyan miwiti karo {start_chips} chip
• Dek tunggal 52 kartu (2♠-A♠, 2♥-A♥, 2♦-A♦, 2♣-A♣)
• Sampeyan main nglawan dealer (omah)
• Saben ronde nututi struktur Ultimate Texas Hold'em: sampeyan ngepos ANTE lan BLIND bet, nampa 2 kartu bolongan, mutuske PLAY bet opsional ing fase pertaruhan, banjur mbukak kartu komunitas lan mbandingake tangan 5-kartu paling apik sampeyan karo dealer. Tujuan sampeyan yaiku nggedhekake kemenangan (nalika sampeyan duwe tangan sing luwih apik), nalika ngurangi kekalahan (nalika sampeyan duwe tangan sing luwih ala).
• Game rampung nalika sampeyan tekan 0 chip utawa kurang ing awal ronde (KEKALAHAN) utawa rampung 1000 ronde karo chip (MENANG)

💰 STRUKTUR PERTARUHAN:
• ANTE: Bet wajib ${ante} saben ronde
• BLIND: Bet wajib ${ante} saben ronde
• PLAY: Bet opsional ing gameplay. Ing ronde, sampeyan mung bisa milih Siji saka sing iki: (${ante4} yen dilakoni ing PRE-FLOP, ${ante2} yen dilakoni ing FLOP, utawa ${ante} yen dilakoni ing RIVER. Uga bisa fold ing river, nyerahake tangan, lan ora mbet.)

🎴 NGEDHAR KARTU:
• Sampeyan nampa 2 kartu sing terbuka (kartu bolongan sampeyan)
• Dealer nampa 2 kartu sing tertutup (tersembunyi saka sampeyan)
• 5 kartu komunitas dibagike tertutup ing awal
• Kartu komunitas dibukak progresif ing fase game

🏆 KUALIFIKASI DEALER:
• Dealer kudu duwe setidaknya sepasang (2 kartu sing padha) kanggo kualifikasi, nggunakake 2 kartu ing tangan lan 5 kartu komunitas.
• Kualifikasi dealer mempengaruhi hasil pertaruhan, sing bakal dijelasake mengko.

🎮 FASE GAME & AKSI:
📋 PRE-FLOP:
  • Aksi: [4x] (${ante4}) utawa [check]
  • [4x]: Taruhan ${ante4} PLAY, mbukak 3 kartu komunitas pertama
  • [check]: Ora mbet tambahan, mbukak 3 kartu komunitas pertama

📋 FLOP:
  • Yen 4x bet dilakoni: Mung [skip] sing kasedhiya (auto-mbukak 2 kartu komunitas terakhir)
  • Yen ora 4x bet: [2x] (${ante2}) utawa [check]
  • [2x]: Taruhan ${ante2} PLAY, mbukak 2 kartu komunitas terakhir
  • [check]: Ora mbet tambahan, mbukak 2 kartu komunitas terakhir

📋 RIVER:
  • Yen 4x utawa 2x bet dilakoni: Mung [skip] sing kasedhiya (auto-lanjut menyang showdown)
  • Yen ora PLAY bet sadurunge: [1x] (${ante}) utawa [fold]
  • [1x]: Taruhan ${ante} PLAY, meneruske showdown
  • [fold]: Nyerahake tangan, kalahake ANTE lan BLIND bet

📋 SHOWDOWN:
  • Kabeh kartu dibukak lan dievaluasi
  • Tangan 5-kartu paling apik saka 7 kartu (2 bolongan + 5 komunitas)
  • Bet diselesaikake miturut aturan pembayaran

💎 PEMBAYARAN BET:
📊 ANTE BET:
  • Dealer ora kualifikasi: PUSH (bet bali)
  • Dealer kualifikasi & sampeyan menang: 1:1 pembayaran (bet + kemenangan)
  • Dealer kualifikasi & sampeyan kalah: Bet kalah
  • Seri: PUSH (bet bali)

📊 BLIND BET:
  • Ora dipengaruhi kualifikasi dealer
  • Sampeyan menang: Bet bali lan pembayaran tambahan miturut kekuatan tangan
  • Sampeyan kalah: Bet kalah
  • Seri: PUSH (bet bali)

📊 TABEL PEMBAYARAN BLIND BET:
  • Royal Flush: 500:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 500}})
  • Straight Flush: 50:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 50}})
  • Four of a Kind: 10:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 10}})
  • Full House: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Flush: 3:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 3}})
  • Straight: 1:1 (${{self.ante_amount * 1}})
  • Kurang saka Straight: Ora ana pembayaran tambahan

📊 PLAY BET:
  • Ora dipengaruhi kualifikasi dealer
  • Perbandingan langsung: Tangan paling apik sampeyan vs tangan paling apik dealer
  • Sampeyan menang: 1:1 pembayaran (bet + kemenangan)
  • Sampeyan kalah: Bet kalah
  • Seri: PUSH (bet bali)

🎯 PERINGKAT TANGAN POKER (Paling apik menyang paling ala):
  1. Royal Flush: A-K-Q-J-10 saka suit sing padha
  2. Straight Flush: 5 kartu berurutan saka suit sing padha
  3. Four of a Kind: 4 kartu sing padha
  4. Full House: 3 kartu sing padha + 2 kartu sing padha
  5. Flush: 5 kartu saka suit sing padha
  6. Straight: 5 kartu berurutan
  7. Three of a Kind: 3 kartu sing padha
  8. Two Pair: 2 pasang kartu sing beda
  9. One Pair: 2 kartu sing padha
  10. High Card: Kartu paling dhuwur menang

⌨️  KOMANDO AKSI:
• [4x] utawa [play bet 4x]: Taruhan ${{self.ante_amount*4}} PLAY
• [2x] utawa [play bet 2x]: Taruhan ${{self.ante_amount*2}} PLAY
• [1x] utawa [play bet 1x]: Taruhan ${{self.ante_amount*1}} PLAY
• [check] utawa [c]: Check (ora mbet tambahan)
• [fold] utawa [f]: Fold (nyerahake tangan)
• [skip] utawa [s]: Skip menyang fase sabanjure (nalika ora perlu aksi)

💡 TIPS STRATEGI:
• Tangan awal sing kuat (pasangan, kartu dhuwur) asring njalari 4x bet
• Pertimbangake kualifikasi dealer - tangan lemah bisa push yen dealer ora kualifikasi
• Bet BLIND bisa banget menguntungke karo tangan sing kuat (Royal Flush = 500:1!)
• Awas chip stack sampeyan! Yen tekan 0 utawa kurang ing awal ronde, sampeyan kalah.

⚠️  CATATAN PENTING:
• Bet ANTE lan BLIND wajib saben ronde
• Bet PLAY opsional lan strategis
• Pastike sampeyan nglakoni aksi sing bener, lan mung siji aksi ing wektu sing padha.
